## Professional Background
Tharusha Kawshalya is a Sri Lankan software engineer and multidisciplinary visual creator. He bridges the gap between complex software architecture (backend microservices, databases, cloud infra) and fluid digital interfaces, complemented by professional studio photography and cinematic visual storytelling.

### Experience
- **Junior Developer @ Arcforth** (Present): Building scalable enterprise web applications, high-performance backends, and modern cloud solutions.
- **Intern Software Engineer @ Syntax Erreur**: Engineered full-stack web platforms and modernized legacy interfaces.
- **Lead Photographer & Videographer @ Studio Zine** (Present): Directing commercial studio portraiture, cinematic video productions, and editorial shoots.

### Education
- **BSc (Hons) Computer Science** (Reading) — University of Westminster
- **Foundation for Higher Education** — Informatics Institute of Technology (IIT)

### Technical Stack & Expertise
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5 Canvas, Framer Motion
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, REST APIs, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Firebase
- **Creative / Media**: Commercial Studio Photography, Editorial Portraiture, Cinematic Videography, DaVinci Resolve, Lightroom, Photoshop
